'''Guun Cutlax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Lord/Legends|lord]] who led the [[Iska pirates/Legends|Iska pirates]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], during the [[Reconquest of the Rim]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Iska pirates were [[Battle of Fanha/Legends|defeated]] by the [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] at the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] astronomical object [[Fanha/Legends|Fanha]].<ref name="Warfare" />

Cutlax escaped into the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] and rendezvoused with [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|holdouts]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Indepent Systems]]&mdash;which had been defeated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[19 BBY/Legends|two years]] earlier&mdash;led by the rogue [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kendu Ultho]]. The [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] led by Cutlax would be [[Battle of Tosste/Legends|defeated]] at the Outer Rim<ref name="Warfare" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TWoDM">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref> [[Tosste/Legends|Tosste]] in 17 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], and Ultho's forces would ultimately suffer a [[Battle of Ogoth Tiir/Legends|defeat]] at the hands of the Empire at the Outer Rim astronomical object [[Ogoth Tiir/Legends|Ogoth Tiir]] later that year.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Guun Cutlax is new – I love a good piratey name.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Tumblr">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/23039847571/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-7|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 7}}</ref>}}
Gunn Gutlax was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" /> In his endnotes to ''The Essential Guide for Warfare'', Fry remarked on how Cutlax was a new character and that he intended for the character's name to sound pirate-like.<ref name="Tumblr" />
